context_stress_protocol.aosc_profile_duration_protocol: 20 mic1 training utterances per each of eight head-training speakers, 250ms silence after every utterance
context_stress_protocol.status: predeclared; identity-head evaluation IDs never appear in context audio or AOSC profile inputs

feature_extraction_protocol.geometry: V3 streaming, 160ms push blocks, committed 80ms feature frames
feature_extraction_protocol.initial_state: fresh empty stream per source utterance
feature_extraction_protocol.mask: Task08 10ms RMS VAD, projected to 80ms frames by majority vote

folds.registry_rule: nested prefix of the fixed per-fold registry order; external user IDs are independent of Sortformer channels
nested prefix of the fixed per-fold registry order; external user IDs are independent of Sortformer channels
nested prefix of the fixed per-fold registry order; external user IDs are independent of Sortformer channels

mic2_protocol: four paired query utterances when available; same source utterance excluded from registration set

preparation_runtime.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 6.1.6 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

vad_parameters.method: 20ms RMS windows at 10ms hop; speech threshold is max(-45 dBFS, peak-window RMS - 28 dB); bridge gaps <= 60ms; drop runs < 30ms

registration_and_query_protocol.actual_speech_duration: sum VAD-active 80ms feature frames; include whole utterances until the budget is reached and report measured overshoot
registration_and_query_protocol.calibration_roles: calibration speakers choose one frozen global open-set threshold per model
registration_and_query_protocol.evaluation_roles: evaluation speakers are excluded from head training, model selection, and threshold selection
registration_and_query_protocol.external_id_rule: user_<speaker_id>; persistent identity is independent of native speaker-channel number

utterance_allocation.microphone_pairing_rule: mic1/mic2 files share one utterance ID and never cross enrollment/query roles

checks: exactly 110 usable speaker IDs per fold
all four speaker role sets are pairwise disjoint
head-training utterance groups are disjoint from registration and independent query groups
mic1 utterance groups are disjoint between registration and independent query per speaker
every mic2 robustness asset is paired to a mic1 query utterance
